images.filename: 24 Kamele ziehen zur Wasserstelle im Ennedi-Gebirge im Tschad.jpg
images.caption: A walled canyon in Chad. A large group of animals, probably camels, are gathered around a waterhole. Some are moving towards it, while others are already gathered around it. There is a patch of land to the left of the waterhole, where some camels are crowded around. There are bushes to the left of the canyon.
